sentences.text:
: 
G.A. 
 Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Aga for the State.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 504/2024, under Sections 498A,
304B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station - Ramgaon, District - Bahraich.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married with the applicant in June, 2023.
Subsequently, the entire matrimonial family killed her daughter for dowry.
As per post mortem report, cause of death is electric burn and co-accused has been enlarged on bail.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering post-mortem report as also the fact that the FIR was lodged in terms of application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and there is no material against the applicant that soon before death,
the victim was subject to physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 03.02.2025 and has no criminal antecedent, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Saneef Khan be released on bail in aforesaid FIR/Case Crime Number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount with the following conditions:
(a) The applicants shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicants shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) November 6, 2025 Mohit Singh/-
